SELECT
    x,
    x IS NULL,
    x IS NOT NULL,
    x IS DISTINCT FROM NULL,
    x IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL,
    NULL IS DISTINCT FROM x,
    NULL IS NOT DISTINCT FROM x,
    x IS DISTINCT FROM 1,
    x IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 1
FROM (VALUES (NULL), (1), (2)) t(x)
ORDER BY x

SELECT
    x,
    (x + 1) IS DISTINCT FROM NULL,
    (x + 1) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL,
    NULL IS DISTINCT FROM (x + 1),
    NULL IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (x + 1)
FROM (VALUES (NULL), (1), (2)) t(x)
ORDER BY x
